review_text: The charging speed at this station is excellent! Got my car to 80% in just 25 minutes using the CCS connector. However, the app kept crashing when I tried to start the session.
Terrible experience. Waited 45 minutes because 2 out of 3 chargers were broken. When I finally got one working, the payment system failed twice. Very frustrating!
Love the location - right next to a coffee shop and grocery store. Makes the 30-minute charge fly by. Prices are reasonable too at $0.35/kWh.
The charger gave me error code E-301 three times before it finally started. Customer support was helpful though - they walked me through a fix over the phone.
Way too expensive compared to other networks. $0.55/kWh is highway robbery. The charging speed was decent but not worth the premium price.
Absolutely love this charging network! Fast, reliable, and the app is super intuitive. Best EV charging experience I've had. The stations are always clean and well-maintained.
App is unusable. Can't find nearby stations, the map doesn't load half the time, and I lost my charging history after the last update. Please fix your software!
Good charging speed but terrible availability. Every time I visit this location, there's a long queue. They need to add more chargers ASAP.
The CHAdeMO connector at this station hasn't worked in weeks. I've reported it multiple times but nothing gets fixed. Very disappointing reliability.
Great improvement suggestion: add real-time queue information to the app so we can plan our charging stops better. Currently it's a guessing game.
Neutral experience overall. Charging worked fine but nothing special. Average speed, average price, average location. It gets the job done.
Super happy with the new payment options! Apple Pay and Google Pay finally work. No more fumbling with credit cards in the rain. 😊👍
The Tesla Supercharger adapter works but the charging speed is significantly reduced. Expected 150kW but only got 50kW. Disappointed.
Customer support took 3 days to respond to my billing complaint. When they did respond, they just sent a generic template. Not helpful at all.
Perfect spot for charging while shopping at the mall. The 2 hours of free charging with purchase is an amazing deal! Will definitely come back. 🎉
The station was in a sketchy area with no lighting. Didn't feel safe charging at night. Please improve the location safety and add proper lighting.
Solid experience. The CCS fast charger delivered as promised - 350kW peak speed. My Hyundai Ioniq 5 charged from 10% to 80% in 18 minutes flat!
ok
Error code F-102 keeps appearing. Multiple chargers at this location seem to have the same firmware issue. Reliability needs serious work.
I suggest they should add a canopy or shelter over the chargers. Charging in rain or extreme sun is not pleasant. Simple improvement that would help a lot.
The charger gave me error code E-301 three times before it finally started. Customer support was helpful though - they walked me through a fix over the phone.
Been using this network for 6 months now. Initially had issues but they've really improved. Faster chargers, better app, and prices dropped. Happy customer! 😃
Charged here yesterday. It was fine.
DO NOT USE THIS STATION! The charger damaged my car's charging port. Cost me $500 to repair. Filing a complaint and considering legal action. Absolutely unacceptable!
The new stations they installed have beautiful displays and are very user-friendly. However, only 1 out of 4 was actually working when I visited. Availability is still a huge problem.
